packages.label: יִרְאָה
packages.reason: These nodes all share the essential nature of Yirah (awe/fear of God). The Rebbe explicitly equates: ארץ = יראה (the earth that 'feared' — 'ארץ יראה' Psalms 76); אלהים = יראה ('את האלהים ירא' Kohelet 12); דבר = יראה ('אז נדברו יראי ה'' Malachi 3 — the word belongs to those who fear); צפור = יראה ('מכנף הארץ זמירות' — the wing of earth, i.e. the bird, = יראה = ארץ, because birds are the earth in flight); צפרדע = עלית היראה לשרשה = דעת (the frog is a compound word צפור + דעה: the bird-part = יראה, the knowledge-part = its root, making the frog the symbol of yirah ascending to its root). All are different facets of the single quality of awe that orients the person toward God.
merge_notes: Raw component A {יראה, ארץ, אלהים, דבר, צפור} (5 nodes) is the core bechina cluster.

Isolated pair {צפרדע, עלית היראה לשרשה} merged here: the frog explicitly IS the ascent of yirah to its root (daat). צפור within צפרדע = יראה; the frog symbol is the יראה-cluster in motion. Shared nature: both are expressions of yirah ascending.

packages.label: דַּעַת
packages.reason: These three nodes share the essential nature of Daat (knowledge / intimate connection). The Rebbe equates: עיני = דעת ('ותפקחנה עיני שניהם' — the opening of eyes = daat; also gematria: daat = 10 names of Hashem = 2 × עין = eyes); שמים = דעת (heaven = fire + water joined together, i.e., the act of union/joining = the very definition of דעת as 'the Adam knew' — union, connection). Daat is the root (שרש) of yirah — the level to which yirah must be raised in order to become pure and transcend the klipa.
merge_notes: No merges. This 3-node component is structurally complete and thematically distinct from יראה — it is the higher level to which יראה is raised, not the same domain.

packages.label: מִשְׁפָּט
packages.reason: These four nodes all share the essential nature of Mishpat (self-judgment, discernment, accounting of one's actions). The Rebbe equates: ישראל = משפט ('חקיו ומשפטיו לישראל' Psalms 147 — Israel IS the people of mishpat); אהרן = משפט ('ונשא אהרן את משפט בני ישראל' Exodus 28 — Aaron bears Israel's judgment); בנאמני = אהרן (from Midrash Shocher Tov — 'those who are faithful/trusted' = Aaron). Mishpat is the practical tool by which yirah ascends to daat: when a person judges himself (mishpat below), heavenly judgment ceases, and the yirah-energy that was trapped in external fears returns to its holy root.
merge_notes: No merges. The 4-node component {משפט, אהרן, ישראל, בנאמני} is structurally coherent. The edge אהרן—בנאמני connects to אהרן—משפט, forming a complete chain.

packages.label: תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּנִגְלֶה
packages.reason: These nodes all share the essential nature of the revealed, public dimension of Torah — accessible to all, universal in its requirement. The Rebbe equates: סיני = תורה שבנגלה (the Talmud: 'Sinai is preferable, because all need the wheat-master' — Sinai is the symbol of what everyone needs, the public Torah); שפלות = סיני (God gave the Torah on Mt. Sinai precisely because it is the lowest mountain — humility is the nature of the revealed Torah that descends to meet all people); ממלכת = תורה שבנגלה ('ממלכת' from the verse 'you shall be to Me a kingdom of priests' — the kingdom aspect = revealed Torah, because 'through it kings reign' and 'there is no king without a people'); מלכות = נגלה ('Malkhut is the aspect of the revealed, because there is no king without a people, and all need the king'). All express the same essential quality: universality, accessibility, the revealed face of Torah.
merge_notes: Raw component {תורה שבנגלה, סיני, שפלות, ממלכת} (4 nodes) is the core.

Isolated pair {מלכות, נגלה} merged here: the Rebbe explicitly states 'מלכות הוא בחינת נגלה' — Malkhut IS the revealed aspect. מלכות shares the exact same essential nature as תורה שבנגלה (both defined by universality: 'all need the king', 'all need the wheat-master'). Shared nature, not cause-and-effect.

packages.label: תְּפִלָּה וְאַבְרָהָם
packages.label_en: Prayer and Abraham — The Pillar of Chesed
packages.reason: These eight nodes all share the essential nature of Tefillah (prayer) as an act of chesed (loving-kindness), embodied in the figure of Abraham. The Rebbe equates: אברהם = תפלה (Abraham's kinyan = prayer; 'Abraham kinyan one' in Avot 6); חסד = אברהם (chesed = Abraham — the loving-kindness of God that makes prayer possible at all, since it is only through chesed that we may call upon God with human descriptions); שתין בתי = חסד ('sixty houses' = chesed = Abraham, from 'sixty are the queens' — Rashi: that is the aspect of Abraham); ששים המה מלכות = אברהם ('sixty are the queens' = the aspect of Abraham); אות סמ״ך = ששים המה מלכות (the letter samekh, which is circular = sixty, connects the sixty queens); 'סמכוני' = אות סמ״ך (the word 'support me' from Song of Songs = the letter samekh); כהן = תפלה ('kohanim are the aspect of prayer, the aspect of Abraham — 'you are a priest forever''). All express the single essential quality: prayer as an expression of divine chesed/Abraham-energy.
merge_notes: No merges needed. This 8-node component was already connected as a single component through the bechina chain: אברהם—חסד—שתין בתי; אברהם—ששים המה מלכות—אות סמ"ך—סמכוני; אברהם—תפלה—כהן.

packages.label: בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְסִתְרֵי אוֹרַיְתָא
packages.label_en: The Temple and Hidden Torah — The Inner Sanctum
packages.reason: These six nodes all share the essential nature of the hidden, unbounded dimension of Torah — accessible only to the very few, attained through self-nullification. The Rebbe equates: בית המקדש = סתרי אוריתא (the Temple = secrets of the Torah, which is called 'kodesh' — 'only those who are sanctified may eat of it'); קדש = בית המקדש (the Temple is 'the aspect of kodesh, the aspect of reishit'); ראשית = קדש ('kodesh is the aspect of reishit'); תורה שבנסתר = חשך ('יָשֶׁת חשֶׁךְ סִתְרוֹ' — the hidden Torah is attained through darkness, i.e. self-nullification, because it is the aspect of darkness due to the depth of what is apprehended — it transcends all finite form). All express the same essential quality: the inner, holy, boundless dimension of Torah that belongs to the World to Come.
merge_notes: Raw component {בית המקדש, סודות התורה, קדש, ראשית} (4 nodes) is the core bechina cluster.

Isolated pair {תורה שבנסתר, חשך} merged here: חשך is the essential quality of the hidden Torah (the Rebbe explicitly states: 'they are the aspect of darkness due to the depth of what is apprehended' — i.e., the darkness IS the hiddenness, which IS the nature of סתרי תורה = בית המקדש = קדש). Shared nature: both pairs are expressions of the same unbounded, inner-sanctum dimension of Torah. The merge is by nature (bechina), not by causal flow.

packages.label: תַּנִּינָא וְנָחָשׁ — תְּפִלָּה לְתוֹעֶלֶת עַצְמוֹ
packages.reason: These two nodes share the essential nature of the serpent (nachash) — the seductive force that corrupts prayer by redirecting it toward self-interest. The Rebbe equates: תנינא = נחש (the Talmudic 'tannina'/sea-monster = the serpent, which seduces the person to pray for personal benefit: 'give us life and sustenance, or other self-interested goals'). The serpent is the evil mirror of prayer (Package 5): where prayer as chesed is offered purely to fill God's desire (satisfying the Divine desire for Israel's prayer), the serpent contaminates prayer by turning it inward — making the worshipper the beneficiary rather than the vehicle of divine pleasure. It is explicitly contrasted with the raven (which swallows the serpent) — the raven representing the one who nullifies self-interest entirely.
merge_notes: This 2-node evil component is kept separate rather than merged into any good package. The serpent/self-serving prayer is the structural antagonist of Package 5 (Prayer/Abraham/Chesed) — it is the evil mirror, not a sub-theme within the good package. Merging it would obscure the Torah's fundamental good/evil polarity structure.
